title_en: Cooking Chinese Dishes (17/20): Sichuan Boiled Fish
note_en: 尽管A，B也/依然… means "even though A, still B": 尽管看起来全是红油和辣椒，鱼肉本身的味道也不会被完全盖住 "even though it looks like nothing but red oil and chilies, the fish's own flavor isn't completely masked." Unlike English "although," Chinese often adds a second marker such as 也, 依然, or 但是 in the main clause to complete the contrast.
